# mtncloud_app (Data Source)

Looks up one app by ID or by name, including one made in the console. An app groups instances deployed together from a blueprint. A name must match exactly one app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_app" "example" {
  name = "my-app"
}

output "app_instances" {
  value = data.mtncloud_app.example.instances
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the app. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the app, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `app_status` (String) Deployment status, for example `completed`.
- `blueprint` (String) Blueprint the app was deployed from, or empty.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `environment` (String) Environment, for example `dev`, or empty.
- `group` (String) Group the app belongs to.
- `instance_count` (Number) Number of instances.
- `instances` (List of Number) IDs of the app's instances.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `owner` (String) Username of the app's owner.
- `status` (String) Status, for example `running`.
- `type` (String) Blueprint type the app was deployed from.
